scope: Local payment-service assurance demonstration only; not a production audit-log implementation.
integrityMechanism: The example uses atomic replacement for durable operation state. Production audit evidence must use the enterprise audit-log design documented separately.
accessControl: The test workspace is created in an OS temporary directory and removed after each Node test.
retention: Synthetic local test records exist only for the test execution and contain no real personal, account, or payment data.
restoreTestEvidence: tests/payment-service.test.js reads the durable operation state through service behavior during retry and conflict tests.
exportTestEvidence: The demonstration has no production audit export; this control is explicitly limited to local fixture evidence.
